CustomField.description: True when bid needs sales action: Viewed unsigned, Expired, or Expired–No Response.
CustomField.formula: OR( AND(Viewed__c = TRUE, TEXT(Contract_Status__c) <> "Signed", TEXT(Stage__c) <> "Closed - WON", TEXT(Stage__c) <> "Closed - LOST"), TEXT(Contract_Status__c) = "Expired", Expired_No_Response__c = TRUE )
CustomField.label: Action Needed
